name: elapsed
description: A website that opens directly on a stopwatch for tracking focused work.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.sw.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p packages/endpoint && tsc -p packages/endpoint/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:contrast && npm run build && npm run check:size
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && node tooling/worker-runtime.ts endpoint && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 deploy --config packages/endpoint/wrangler.jsonc --env test
scripts.deploy:soon: node tooling/worker-runtime.ts soon && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 deploy --config packages/soon/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && node tooling/worker-runtime.ts endpoint && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 deploy --config packages/endpoint/wrangler.jsonc
